title: Nouns and the Genitive
subtitle: Plural -es, genitive -es — the case system collapses.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Plural: add -es or -s. Genitive (possessive): add -es or -s. The four-case system of Old English is gone. The knightes tale = the knight's tale. The knightes = the knights. Word order matters more than case.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Nouns and the Genitive.
